latest.notes:
Replacing audio with a file already in the station folder no longer duplicates it.

• When the replacement you pick is already inside Avvio's audio folders — culling duplicates, for instance — it is now renamed into place rather than copied, so the same audio no longer ends up in the folder twice under two names.
• Picking a replacement from anywhere else (a Downloads folder, a drive) still copies it, so your own file is never moved or taken away.
• If the rename can't be completed, the file is put back exactly where you picked it from.

Includes v0.5.82: Replace Audio working when the old file has already been removed.
